set.body:
Define StatMap, ParameterMap, ContrastMap, ResultManifest, and AnalysisProvenance as typed shared result artifacts. Add JVM writer adapters for NIfTI/HDF5/GDS/BIDS-style output later without polluting shared fit logic.

Acceptance: result bundles preserve statistic kind, contrast id, coefficient names, voxel/sample space, provenance, and export intent; JVM adapters are thin and tested separately; existing ImageMaps behavior remains compatible.
set.title: Add typed result bundles and export adapters
